description.value: At 9th level, any illusion spell the illusionist casts with a duration of 'concentration' lasts a number of additional rounds equal to half of the illusionist's level after he stops maintaining concentration (minimum +1 round). At 20th level, the illusionist can make one illusion spell with a duration of 'concentration' become permanent. The illusionist can have no more than one illusion made permanent in this way at one time. If he designates another illusion as permanent, the previous permanent illusion ends.
